entries.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve style redesign. Create a brand-new character expression sheet in a Makoto Shinkai inspired contemporary Japanese animated feature-film aesthetic. The input image provides ONLY Xiaocui's identity, exact hair color, hairstyle, clothing and accessories. DO NOT copy its 1990s drawing style or face proportions. Xiaocui retains dark emerald/teal twin-tails, bright pink ribbons, teal irises, white sailor blouse with teal collar and pink bow. Clearly redesign rendering to modern cinematic anime: slender exceptionally clean delicate contour lines; believable restrained youthful facial proportions; smaller natural almond-shaped eyes and subtle iris highlights, NOT huge glittering doll eyes; slightly longer natural nose/face proportions; luminous translucent layered hair; smooth elegant cel gradients, clear clean shadow shapes with nuanced subtle color; cool cyan/violet ambient reflection and warm sunset backlight/rim highlights. Premium hand-drawn animated film character design, tender realistic emotion, NOT photo or 3D. NO painterly brush texture, NO impasto, NO heavy black outlines, NO 90s cel look, NO chibi. EXACTLY FIVE distinct waist-up/head-and-shoulders busts in one horizontal row, equal-width cells separated by generous transparent gutters. Left to right: normal quiet closed-mouth smile, happy open smile with softened happy eyes, surprised raised brows and small open mouth, sad worried brows with downturned lips, win proud joyful grin and slight head tilt. Same scale, outfit and identity in every cell; each full hair/shoulder silhouette fits inside its own cell with space on every side. Busts only, no hands or props. ACTUAL transparent RGBA everywhere outside each isolated portrait; no background rectangle, glow cloud, landscape, scenery, labels, words, borders or watermark. Requested 2560x768.
